newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova raises discount rate to 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moldova raises discount rate to 22 pct.

text.p: Moldova's National Bank on Wednesday raised its official discount rate to 22 percent annual from 21 percent effective since October 24, a report from the National Bank said.
The new rate was set at a credit funds auction, when 11 banks acquired a total of 26.06 million lei ($5.57 million) of National Bank reserves.

Trailing low inflation, official discount rates have fallen from a high of 377 percent set in February 1994. The National Bank has eliminated soft loans to the economy by selling up to 90 percent of its credit funds at regular auctions.
Officials expect annual inflation to fall this year to some 17 percent from 23.8 percent in 1995.
